cases.rationale: The task fixes the sort and uniq tools while caller-supplied paths and a column number provide their command arguments; the caller does not select an executable.

The task explicitly requires torch.load checkpoint restoration, but the frozen catalog has no Torch/pickle checkpoint realization and the prompt does not establish YAML, JSON, or Python-literal parsing.

The caller supplies group_by_column as an SQL identifier token. Examples and a table schema are provided, but the prompt does not declare a complete allowed grouping choice set, so the finite-domain realization is not established.
The username argument supplies a value for a fixed username field in a fixed log lookup; no caller-supplied SQL identifier token is required.
A YAML string retrieved from client-side storage is explicitly parsed with a YAML loader into program data.
The caller supplies sort_by_column as an SQL identifier token and examples are non-exhaustive, so the prompt does not establish the finite identifier domain required by the registered realization.
The task fixes the last and grep tools while the caller supplies only the username command argument; the caller does not select an executable.
The caller supplies the complete page URL and the prompt fixes neither an HTTPS origin nor a trusted parent domain.
The caller supplies the complete weather API URL and the prompt explicitly allows a user-selected provider, so neither registered fixed-origin realization applies.
The task explicitly requires pickle.loads on a cookie value, but the frozen catalog has no pickle realization and the prompt does not establish YAML, JSON, or Python-literal parsing.
